method: Bounded static source review; no new synthetic/live executions.

items.finding: Exact provider/model descriptor supplied by trusted application; explicit endpoint/credential; no discovery.
HTTPS, no redirects/automatic retries; bounded JSON chat envelope. image_url / input_audio via media subclass; sampled video images, not native video.
Exact returned model/provider/request/digest fences; no model alias substitution to satisfy a mismatch.
Source-only citation context and typed media; existing privacy/scope/support gates retained. Live outbound canary still requires actual wire inspection.
MEDIA proposals lack goals/code authority; beliefs stay model-derived; CALLING becomes UNKNOWN without provider recall. Historical H1 tests not new live proof.

Selected usage, byte counts, requested/returned identity and correlation retained. Native provider response ID/header ID and raw wire-response fingerprint are not currently retained in CognitionReply. Qualification must add a bounded sanitized measurement path before live acceptance; proposal/reply digest is not raw response digest.

Prior narrow color/tone fixtures are not object/OCR/ASR quality qualification. New independently labelled public cases, repeats, canary, modality metrics and provider-specific capability checks needed. Not generated because no-provider stop branch applies.

Reservation ceiling distinct from selected usage; real cost defaults UNKNOWN. No provider prices or explicit model parameters available; per-modality total-call caps and pricing reviewed only once exact provider supplied. No accurate cost inferred from tokens.
